about:
Based in Mobile, Alabama, All Plastics & Fiberglass Inc operates from 8201 Zeigler Boulevard. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed; Chris Bailey is listed as a primary contact.

The company specializes in the fabrication of Fiberglass Reinforced Plastics (FRP), producing tanks, hoods and vents, ducts and stacks, grating, pipes and piping systems, structural shapes, platform and siding, and fiberglass pipe hangers. It also pre-fabricates piping systems, structural platforms, handrails, walkways, grating, and buildings. In-house services include engineering, computer-aided design and drafting, and field erection and repair. The firm stocks a range of industrial plastics such as Kynar, CPVC, and Teflon in various shapes and forms.

All Plastics & Fiberglass serves industrial customers requiring corrosion-resistant FRP solutions, though specific industry sectors are not identified on its website. Its products address corrosion problems across applications that demand custom-fabricated plastic and fiberglass components.

The company emphasizes high-quality, competitively priced FRP fabrication manufactured to meet each customer's specific needs, supported by engineering expertise and a stock of specialty plastics for quick turnaround.
